stem: Which fraction is the same as 0.25?
hints: Count the digits after the decimal point. Two digits means hundredths.
0.25 is 25 hundredths, so write it as 25/100.
Simplify 25/100 by dividing the top and the bottom by 25.

solution.methodName: Write as tenths or hundredths, then simplify

steps.why: There are 2 digits after the point, so the last digit is in the hundredths place.
Dividing the top and the bottom by the same number keeps the value the same.
Think of money: four 25-centavo coins make ₱1.

trapNotes.2/5: This uses the digits 2 and 5 as the top and the bottom. But 2/5 = 0.4, not 0.25.
trapNotes.1/25: This puts 25 on the bottom. 1/25 is a very small part (0.04). Write 0.25 as 25/100 first.
trapNotes.25/10: This reads 0.25 as tenths. 25/10 is 2.5, more than 2 wholes. Two digits after the point means hundredths.
